Here’s how you can update your contact or account details with NOBULL:

Email address: For security, email changes are not supported. If you need a different email, please create a new account. Loyalty points and memberships cannot be transferred to a new email.
Password: Use the "Forgot Your Password" page to reset your password by following the instructions sent to your email.
Shipping or payment for subscriptions: Log in, go to Manage Subscription, and select Edit next to the relevant section to update your shipping address or payment method.
Other subscription changes: From Manage Subscription, you can edit, skip, pause, or cancel deliveries, change frequency, swap items, or update details before your next shipment.
Email and text preferences: Manage your marketing preferences on the preferences page or reply STOP to opt out of SMS messages.

If you have a specific detail in mind, please refer to the matching option above.
